verdict.rationale: Box AI API/Box AI in the product provides Q&A, extraction, summarization, and metadata generation directly on content stored in Box (box-docs-9, box-docs-12, box-docs-13, box-docs-26), with enterprise permissions preserved and configurable underlying models (box-docs-16, box-docs-18). This directly delivers AI-generated insights/suggestions from user data within the product, backed by first-party docs though lacking independent hands-on validation. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of Box AI insight quality and no community evidence testing accuracy of the AI features.
